Scene Breakdown:
- L0001-L0044: Abhi on phone with his Dad. Dad wants him to meet Harshitba for marriage. Setup.
- L0045-L0085: Harshitha confronts Abhi outside Meera's flat; Abhi explains his one-sided love logic. Conflict.
- L0086-L0117: Meera appears calling him 'Vijay'. Harshitha realizes his fake identity and forces her way into the flat. Conflict / Escalation.
- L0118-L0165: Inside flat: Harshitha quizzes him in front of Meera; Abhi frantically covers up name and college details. Comedic tension.
- L0166-L0214: Prank travel agent call trying to bribe Harshitha with a free Bangkok trip. Comedy.
- L0215-L0279: Harshitha stays in the flat; Dad calls and Harshitha answers. Conflict.
- L0280-L0333: Cafe scene: Harshitha talks to Sindhu; Sindhu interrogates her background; Harshitha gives rich-to-poor punchline. Comedy.
- L0334-L0365: Kitchen scene: Abhi cuts onions, Meera gets teary, Abhi tends to her eyes. Romance.
- L0366-L0386: Harshitha asks Meera if she also loves Vijay. Romantic / emotional probe.
- L0387-L0424: Abhi drops Harshitha off; she gracefully departs with advice on love. Resolution.
- L0425-L0451: Abhi and friend have beer; friend reminds him his wealth is the real barrier. Reality check.
- L0452-L0458: Dad enters the cafe asking for Abhi. Cliffhanger ending.

proposals.text: నువ్వు విజయ్ తో room share చేసుకుంటున్నావు కదా, నీకెప్పుడు ఇబ్బంది అనిపించలేదా? విజయ్ తోనా? మొదట ఇబ్బందిగానే అనిపించింది. కానీ తర్వాత చాలా మంచోడని అర్థమైంది. ఊమ్. నీకెప్పుడూ doubt కూడా రాలేదా? Doubt దేనికి? విజయ్ నిన్ను love చేస్తున్నాడేమోనని. అలా ఎప్పుడూ అనిపించలేదే. ఎందుకంటే, నువ్వు కూడా love చేస్తున్నావేమో. ఛా, అలా ఏం లేదు. లేకపోతే మంచిదే.
